_comment: Inference configuration for the neurite/soma model. These are NOT tunables: every number here is part of the configuration the held-out Dice (neurite 0.832 / soma 0.915) was measured with, and the one the numerical-equivalence check against nnUNetv2_predict was run at. Changing any of them invalidates both. The label ids are deliberately NOT here: they come from the checkpoint's own dataset.json, checked against wrapper.EXPECTED_LABELS at load.
